# aphex-swift

**A minimal Swift CLI tool leveraging the PhotoKit frameworks for querying and exporting photos and albums from the macOS Photos.app library.**

## Overview

This tool is intended for use by the Aphex TypeScript library.

Works _only_ with the system photo library. There is no way to define a custom Photos library.

Returns JSON for easy parsing in scripts.

TODO `photos://` or similar URL scheme support?

TODO Flag to force photos only?

## Usage

### Command: `aphex-swift`

<!-- cli-help { cliCommand: "./dist/aphex-swift" }  -->

```txt
OVERVIEW: A multi-command CLI tool for managing photo albums

USAGE: aphex <subcommand>

OPTIONS:
  -h, --help              Show help information.

SUBCOMMANDS:
  albums                  Get album paths mapped to their UUIDs as JSON
  info                    Get photo asset information for given identifiers
                          (UUID, filename, album name, or photo path)
  export                  Export photos for given identifiers to a destination
                          directory

  See 'aphex help <subcommand>' for detailed help.
```

<!-- /cli-help -->

### Subcommand: `aphex-swift albums`

<!-- cli-help { cliCommand: "./dist/aphex-swift", helpFlag: "albums --help" }  -->

```txt
OVERVIEW: Get album paths mapped to their UUIDs as JSON

USAGE: aphex albums

OPTIONS:
  -h, --help              Show help information.

```

<!-- /cli-help -->

### Subcommand: `aphex-swift info`

<!-- cli-help { cliCommand: "./dist/aphex-swift", helpFlag: "info --help" }  -->

```txt
OVERVIEW: Get photo asset information for given identifiers (UUID, filename,
album name, or photo path)

USAGE: aphex info [--case-sensitive] <identifiers> ...

ARGUMENTS:
  <identifiers>           Photo or album identifiers (UUIDs, filenames, album
                          names, or photo paths)

OPTIONS:
  -c, --case-sensitive    Case sensitive matching
  -h, --help              Show help information.

```

<!-- /cli-help -->

### Subcommand: `aphex-swift export`

<!-- cli-help { cliCommand: "./dist/aphex-swift", helpFlag: "export --help" }  -->

```txt
OVERVIEW: Export photos for given identifiers to a destination directory

USAGE: aphex export [--case-sensitive] --destination <destination> <identifiers> ...

ARGUMENTS:
  <identifiers>           Photo or album identifiers (UUIDs, filenames, album
                          names, or photo paths)

OPTIONS:
  -c, --case-sensitive    Case sensitive matching
  -d, --destination <destination>
                          Destination directory for exported photos
  -h, --help              Show help information.

```

<!-- /cli-help -->

## Examples

```sh
swift run aphex export "test-album" --destination "/Users/mika/Desktop" | jq
```
